verdict.rationale: Sierra's docs say one agent can be built once and deployed across chat, phone, email, SMS and 'messaging', and published to ChatGPT, so the omnichannel core of the story is covered. The specific channels this story names beyond chat and email are not documented, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: explicit in-app, Slack, WhatsApp and social channel support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, one agent covers chat, email, and in-app, plus the channels my customers actually use — Slack, WhatsApp, social

citations.quote: Build once and deploy across any channel—chat, phone, email, SMS, and messaging.
Make your agent available on ChatGPT with the push of a button, or via CI/CD.
